classification.difficultyReason: Count the separate cubes and multiply by the explicitly supplied volume x³.

content.prompt: The volume of each cube is $x^3$. Write an expression for each total volume.

spec.description: Four separate cubes in two rows of two. Each cube shows its front, top and right faces, with a consistent viewing direction.
spec.mathematics: Every cube has volume x³. Three visible faces are explicit; hidden back edges are omitted as in the source.
spec.answerVisibility: All cubes are permanent givens; the total volume appears only in answers.

answer.worked: There are four cubes, so the total volume is $4\times x^3=4x^3$.

spec.description: Six separate cubes in three rows of two. Each cube shows its front, top and right faces.
spec.mathematics: Every cube has volume x³. Explicit visible faces share a consistent viewing direction; hidden back edges are omitted.
spec.answerVisibility: All cubes are permanent givens; the total volume appears only in answers.

answer.worked: There are six cubes, so the total volume is $6\times x^3=6x^3$.

spec.description: Eight separate cubes in rows of three, three and two. The bottom pair aligns with the first two columns.
spec.mathematics: Every cube has volume x³. Each has explicit front, top and right visible faces, with hidden back edges omitted.
spec.answerVisibility: All cubes are permanent givens; the total volume appears only in answers.

answer.worked: There are eight cubes, so the total volume is $8\times x^3=8x^3$.
